prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE photorealistic cinematic 16:9 starting image for a running commuter shot, with an extreme close UNDER-CHIN FISHEYE CAMERA.

REFERENCE ROLES: Images 1 and 2 establish Riley Brooks's exact identity and hair. Image 3 establishes white collar, burgundy lanyard and black bag strap on her anatomical RIGHT shoulder. Image 4 establishes the futuristic station materials, roof, skylights and daylight. Image 5 illustrates the STRONG degree of fisheye optical distortion only: use neither its person nor its overhead camera angle, circular border, setting, lettering, sunglasses or watermark.

CAMERA IS THE MAIN REQUIREMENT: lens sits extremely close immediately BELOW and slightly IN FRONT OF her CHIN, pointing steeply UPWARD, as if on a short invisible head-mounted rig. Pronounced near-180-degree full-frame fisheye. The underside of her chin is very near the lens and dominates the LOWER CENTER foreground, her jaw and lower face enlarged by perspective, her mouth above it, nose and eyes higher and receding, forehead farther away. We look UP past her chin toward her face and station ceiling. This must be unmistakably a below-chin view, not a normal portrait or a camera at chest distance. Her chin stays inside the frame rather than cropped off. Her whole face is recognizable despite exaggerated fixed optical perspective. Strongly bow the station roof beams and light strips around the face. No circular black border: fill the rectangular widescreen canvas edge to edge.

SUBJECT: Riley Brooks, fictional 27-year-old slim brunette woman, exact same facial identity as references 1 and 2, chin-length side-parted dark-brown bob, brown eyes, natural skin detail, single mole beneath her anatomical LEFT eye (viewer RIGHT in an unmirrored frontal image). She's running to catch her train, eyes focused ahead beyond the lens, lips parted with exertion and panting, no grin. A few bob strands lift with running. Her white opaque long-sleeved shirt collar, burgundy #8b1e2d lanyard segments and right-shoulder black bag strap peek in at the lower outer edges. Keep the crop overwhelmingly face/chin and ceiling; no waist, legs or badge insert.

SCENE: same original dark-metal arched futuristic commuter station as image 4, cyan and magenta linear lights and diffuse cool 8:30am skylight. The ceiling fills the background behind/around her and bends strongly at the edges through the fisheye. Believable live-action materials and exposure. Station train-door reveal belongs to the next shot; no prominent door in this composition.

This is a sharp starting still for later head-attached animation: fixed close distance between camera and chin; her chin will remain roughly anchored while the background bobs/rolls. Do not depict that movement with smeared blur. No visible rig, arms holding a camera, unrelated people, cybernetic implants, face replacement, text, stock marks, illustrations, collage, panels or black corners. Preserve identity and wardrobe; change camera perspective dramatically from the ordinary portrait references.
review: Visually inspected: close upward under-chin framing, strong ceiling curvature, parted lips, brown bob, white collar, burgundy lanyard and right-shoulder strap retained. Mole is subtle at this angle; verify continuity in the video test. Selected as a test starting frame, not user-approved final. Camera-following motion cannot be validated in a still.
